definitions.gloss: ascending and descending; going up and down
definitions.explanation: The action of moving up and down, typically referring to riding elevators, climbing stairs, or the mechanical raising and lowering of equipment.

examples.japanese: {昇降|しょうこう}{口|ぐち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦エレベーター→エレベーター：01340_erebeetaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{昇降|しょうこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
{昇降|しょうこう} is a formal compound combining ⟦{昇|のぼ}る→昇る：12960_noboru⟧ (to ascend) and ⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧ (to descend). It appears frequently in signage, instructions, and technical descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昇降|しょうこう}{口|ぐち} (entrance/exit for boarding, as on a bus or train platform)
- {昇降|しょうこう}{機|き} (elevator, lift mechanism)
- {昇降|しょうこう}{式|しき} (height-adjustable, as in {昇降|しょうこう}{式|しき}⟦デスク→デスク：23405_desuku⟧ — standing desk)
